statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2023-0089 marks atomic-polyfill as unmaintained. Teleport and tsh Rust binaries include the crate per the teleport-cargo and tsh-cargo SPDX SBOMs built from the teleport HSP package. Resolving the advisory requires upstream Teleport or a Cargo.lock update in package/main/teleport; reachability and migration options are under assessment.
